name: autowrite
description: Two skills for a complete resume workflow. (1) career-intake: human-in-the-loop interview that itemizes a candidate's work into a structured supplementary-context library (interview-notes/, bullets/, narratives/, and a draft resume). (2) autowrite: autonomous evaluator and mutator that scores the resume across multiple target companies, locks per-company variants when convergence holds, then discovers active job openings (with full audit trail of every role considered, included or excluded, and active-status verification on each URL), builds role-specific hiring-manager profiles, and produces opening-tailored resume variants. Locked variants and per-opening resumes render to print-ready HTML alongside markdown sources. Dashboard adds a TOC + per-company index pages. autowrite's mutation engine auto-loads career-intake's library so factual phrasings can be pulled in without fabrication. Modeled on Karpathy's autoresearch methodology applied to resume content with multi-agent orchestration.
